create_op3_env: create an Op3Env instance with an xml path and config for the OP3 robot simulation
get_op3_assets: get a dictionary of model assets from the OP3 robot xml and menagerie paths
get_op3_gravity: get the gravity vector in the world frame from an Op3Env simulation data
get_op3_linvel: get the linear velocity of the OP3 robot in the world or local frame from simulation data
get_op3_sensor_readings: get accelerometer, gyroscope, and angular velocity sensor readings from an Op3Env simulation
